project.name: EdgeLoan
project.objective: Advanced loan management system with multi-language support and modern UI/UX

epics.title: Advanced User Management System
epics.description: Enhanced user management with role-based permissions, profile management, audit trails, and security features
epics.business_value: Core security foundation and user experience enhancement
user_stories: As an administrator, I want to manage user roles and permissions so that I can control system access
As a user, I want to update my profile information so that my data stays current
As an administrator, I want to view user activity logs so that I can monitor system usage
acceptance_criteria: Multi-language support for all user-facing text
features: Enhanced role management with granular permissions
User profile editing with image upload
risks: Security implementation complexity - Mitigated by security review at each milestone
Role permission matrix complexity - Mitigated by incremental implementation

epics.title: Loan Application Processing System
epics.description: Complete loan application workflow with document upload, review process, approval system, and status tracking
epics.business_value: Primary business functionality for loan processing
user_stories: As a customer, I want to submit a loan application online so that I can apply for financing conveniently
As a loan officer, I want to review applications with all supporting documents so that I can make informed decisions
As an administrator, I want to track application statuses so that I can monitor processing efficiency
acceptance_criteria: Complete loan application form with validation
features: Loan application form with dynamic validation
Secure document upload with virus scanning
risks: Document storage security - Mitigated by encrypted storage and access controls
Integration complexity with external services - Mitigated by abstraction layer
Regulatory compliance requirements - Mitigated by legal review

epics.title: Document Management System
epics.description: Comprehensive document storage, organization, version control, and secure access management system
epics.business_value: Essential for regulatory compliance and organizational efficiency
user_stories: As a user, I want to upload and organize my documents securely so that they are safely stored
As a loan officer, I want to access relevant documents quickly so that I can process applications efficiently
As an administrator, I want to control document access permissions so that sensitive information is protected
acceptance_criteria: Secure file upload with type and size validation
features: Permission matrix for granular access control
risks: Storage scalability - Mitigated by cloud storage integration
Performance with large files - Mitigated by streaming and chunked uploads
Data privacy compliance - Mitigated by encryption and audit logging

tasks.title: Implement Enhanced Role Management System
tasks.description: Create a flexible role management system with granular permissions, allowing administrators to define custom roles and assign specific permissions to users
acceptanceCriteria: Role entity created with proper Doctrine mapping
Permission entity created with relationship to roles
RoleRepository with methods for role management
Admin interface for role creation and editing
Role assignment interface for users
Permission checking middleware implemented
Multi-language support for role names and descriptions
Database migration created and tested
Comprehensive unit and integration tests

testStrategy.unitTests: Test Role and Permission entities, repository methods, form validation
testStrategy.integrationTests: Test role assignment workflow, permission checking, admin interface
testStrategy.securityTests: Test unauthorized access prevention, privilege escalation protection
testStrategy.manualTests: Test role management UI across different screen sizes and languages

definition_of_done: Code implemented according to Symfony best practices
All unit tests written and passing (minimum 90% coverage)
Database migration tested in development environment

tasks.title: Create User Profile Management Interface
tasks.description: Build a comprehensive user profile management system allowing users to update their personal information, change passwords, upload profile pictures, and manage account preferences
acceptanceCriteria: User profile form with validation implemented
Profile image upload with file validation
Password change functionality with security checks
Account preferences management
Responsive design across all breakpoints
Multi-language form labels and validation messages
File upload security measures implemented
Form CSRF protection enabled
Success and error message handling

testStrategy.unitTests: Test form validation, file upload validation, password change logic
testStrategy.integrationTests: Test complete profile update workflow, image upload process
testStrategy.securityTests: Test file upload security, password validation, CSRF protection
testStrategy.accessibilityTests: Test form accessibility, keyboard navigation, screen reader compatibility
testStrategy.manualTests: Test UI responsiveness, multi-language display, user experience flow

definition_of_done: File upload functionality secure and functional
Responsive design verified on all breakpoints
Unit tests written and passing (minimum 85% coverage)

tasks.title: Create Loan Application Entity and Repository
tasks.description: Implement the core LoanApplication entity with all required fields, relationships, and validation constraints, along with a comprehensive repository for data operations
acceptanceCriteria: LoanApplication entity created with proper Doctrine annotations
All required fields defined with appropriate validation constraints
Relationships with User entity established
Status enum implemented with all loan states
Repository class created with essential query methods
Database migration generated and tested
Unit tests written with comprehensive coverage
Multi-language field support implemented

required_fields: status (enum: draft, submitted, under_review, approved, rejected, cancelled)

testStrategy.unitTests: Test entity creation, validation constraints, status transitions, relationship integrity
testStrategy.integrationTests: Test database persistence, repository methods, migration execution
testStrategy.performanceTests: Test query performance with large datasets

definition_of_done: Code follows Symfony and project conventions

pending.description: Task is defined but not yet started

in_progress.description: Task is actively being worked on

review.description: Task implementation is complete, awaiting review

completed.description: Task is fully completed and verified

blocked.description: Task cannot proceed due to external dependency
